intro: One medium boiled sweet potato (about 150g) has about 130 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from starch and the natural sugar in sweet potato.

variants.name: Air fryer sweet potato with 1 tsp oil

diet: Yes, boiled sweet potato is one of the most diet-friendly carb choices. It has fibre, a natural sweetness and keeps you full. But it's still a carb, so count it in your daily intake. Purple or orange, the calories are about the same.
tips: Boil a big batch and keep it in the fridge for 3 days of breakfast.
Eat it with 2 boiled eggs for a breakfast with protein.
Skip the sugar or condensed milk, sweet potato is already sweet enough.

swap.name: Boiled pumpkin, 1 cup
swap.why: Big volume with fewer calories, good if you want a lighter carb.

faq.q: Is purple sweet potato healthier than orange?
faq.a: Both are good. Purple has antioxidant pigments, orange is high in vitamin A. Pick whichever you like.

faq.q: Is it okay to eat sweet potato at night?
faq.a: Okay. What matters is your total calories for the day. Sweet potato can replace rice at dinner if you like.
Yes, as long as it's washed clean. The skin gives extra fibre.
